instruction.text: Ali has these digit cards. He uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Ali puts the 1 in the hundreds place. Write the largest three-digit number that Ali could make.

Lawrence has these digit cards. He uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Lawrence puts the 6 in the ones place. Write the largest three-digit number that Lawrence could make.

Lara has these digit cards. She uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Lara puts the 6 in the tens place. Write the lowest three-digit number that Lara could make.

Irina has these digit cards. She uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Irina puts the 5 in the tens place. Write the largest three-digit number that Irina could make.

Sophie has these digit cards. She uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Sophie puts the 1 in the hundreds place. Write the largest three-digit number that Sophie could make.

Mohammed has these digit cards. He uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Mohammed puts the 0 in the ones place. Write the lowest three-digit number that Mohammed could make.

Mary has these digit cards. She uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Mary puts the 6 in the tens place. Write the largest three-digit number that Mary could make.

Yazmin has these digit cards. She uses three of the cards to make a three-digit number. Each card can be used only once. Yazmin puts the 5 in the hundreds place. Write the lowest three-digit number that Yazmin could make.
